# BAD-068 — Give _shared/collab.mjs's cleanDisplay a JSDoc signature so its email parameter is not inferred as null

## Brief
collab/gate.ts now has to declare Caller.email as 'any' rather than 'string', purely to keep the collab function's deno-check error set at the three TS7006 errors main prints. The cause is outside collab/: _shared/collab.mjs:434 declares 'export function cleanDisplay(raw, email = null)' with no JSDoc, so TypeScript infers the second parameter as 'null' and rejects a string argument (TS2345). Before BAD-047 the call sites compiled only because 'email' inherited 'any' from an untyped licence row — the check was passing by accident, not by agreement. Every future reader of Caller sees a field typed 'any' with a seven-line comment explaining that it is a lie of convenience.

Evidence: On the BAD-047 branch, annotating Caller.email as 'string' makes 'deno check --node-modules-dir=none server/supabase/functions/collab/index.ts' print five errors instead of three: the three known TS7006 plus two new 'TS2345: Argument of type string is not assignable to parameter of type null | undefined' at collab/index.ts:119 and :200, both 'cleanDisplay(body.display, email)'. Source: server/supabase/functions/_shared/collab.mjs:434-439. Runtime behaviour is already correct ('String(email == null ? "" : email)'), so the fix is a JSDoc '@param {string|null} [email]' (displayForMember at :449 has the same shape and the same gap). It must land together with tightening Caller.email, because either alone leaves the pair disagreeing. Deliberately NOT done in BAD-047: the ticket is a pure move and _shared/collab.mjs is read by web/, mobile/ and the Edge Functions alike.
